verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own AI Receptionist is documented to "answer and route calls on any phone system," which covers AI answering and implies routing to people, and its Agentic Voice AI platform claims to automate customer interactions end-to-end. Both are one-line marketing claims, and nothing documents the AI taking a message or describes how the human handoff works. missing for 10: evidence the AI agent captures and delivers messages, explicit documentation of handoff/escalation to a human agent, in-depth docs on AI Receptionist configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration
